//: Shape only. Real values come from environment variables in staging and production: Storage__Endpoint, Storage__AccessKey, Storage__SecretKey, Storage__Bucket, Auth__DeviceToken, Stt__Azure__Key, Stt__Azure__Region, Anthropic__ApiKey, Reporting__Smtp__Host, Reporting__Smtp__Username, Reporting__Smtp__Password, Reporting__FromAddress, Hangfire__DashboardUser, Hangfire__DashboardPassword. Startup fails if the storage and auth ones are missing; the AI keys deliberately do not stop the host, they park entries in needs_review.
//reporting: B6. Reporting__Smtp__Host / __Username / __Password and Reporting__FromAddress come from environment variables. NEVER point this at port 25 on the VPS: Hetzner blocks outbound 25 by default and a fresh VPS IP has no sending reputation, so the report that IS the product lands in the client spam folder. Use an authenticated relay on 587 (StartTls) or 465 (SslOnConnect), and publish SPF, DKIM and DMARC for the FromAddress domain. An unconfigured relay does not stop the host booting; it stops confirmed entries with delivery_not_configured.
